title: Edison The Ask

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: That's me: always one to believe in helpin' others. Hey-so-listen, caught word of a possible breach in the Localized Unity Zone and thought you should know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's me: always one to believe in helpin' others. Hey-so-listen, caught word of a possible breach in the Localized Unity Zone and thought you should know.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Eh, just passing information along. Rumors have it CorpSec is increasing the frequency of raids. I'd make sure everything's on the up and up, and you don't have any health code violations going on.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh, just passing information along. Rumors have it CorpSec is increasing the frequency of raids. I'd make sure everything's on the up and up, and you don't have any health code violations going on.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Listen, I can steer the badges in the other direction if you want. File a false complaint on a joint uptown.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Listen, I can steer the badges in the other direction if you want. File a false complaint on a joint uptown.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Of course. Folks like us? We're in this mess together. Plus, I might need help with something. Hoping maybe if I did you a favor, you might entertain the idea.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Of course. Folks like us? We're in this mess together. Plus, I might need help with something. Hoping maybe if I did you a favor, you might entertain the idea.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: See, I knew you had some business savvy in you. Looking at the angles. Asking the questions.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: See, I knew you had some business savvy in you. Looking at the angles. Asking the questions.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Look, just give me a hand, please?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, just give me a hand, please?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: It's a package for some Gen Debtors. Young ones, like still in their single-digits and utterly fucked by the system. So, think you can help me out or what? I mean, it's for the kids.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's a package for some Gen Debtors. Young ones, like still in their single-digits and utterly fucked by the system. So, think you can help me out or what? I mean, it's for the kids.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: I knew you'd come through. Hot damn, we're gonna do big things. Big, big things. I'll be in touch soon.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I knew you'd come through. Hot damn, we're gonna do big things. Big, big things. I'll be in touch soon.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: That sucks. No worries. I'll, um, I'll figure something out.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That sucks. No worries. I'll, um, I'll figure something out.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: New route's got me on the other side of the city and I need help getting something to the Stacks. Can't really wait... Don't wanna take a chance on the LUZ, ugh... contracting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: New route's got me on the other side of the city and I need help getting something to the Stacks. Can't really wait... Don't wanna take a chance on the LUZ, ugh... contracting.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: You'd be surprised at the things you see, especially when you're in and out of storage rooms.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'd be surprised at the things you see, especially when you're in and out of storage rooms.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: You know those magnet boards people put on things so they can stack them together and still have some space in between? You know, to make getting them easier?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know those magnet boards people put on things so they can stack them together and still have some space in between? You know, to make getting them easier?

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Well, if you stack two standard bins on top of each other with a magnet spacer, it makes the top bin level with a toilet. Which normally isn't a big deal, unless a place is storing it in the bathroom.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, if you stack two standard bins on top of each other with a magnet spacer, it makes the top bin level with a toilet. Which normally isn't a big deal, unless a place is storing it in the bathroom.

nodes.speaker: Edison Mattix
nodes.text: Well, I'll be damned. Not only are you still in business but you got more customers than I'da ever guessed. Good for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well, I'll be damned. Not only are you still in business but you got more customers than I'da ever guessed. Good for you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Your gift helped. I appreciate it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your gift helped. I appreciate it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Your gift helped. I appreciate it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Your gift helped. I appreciate it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Hey, thanks for keeping the faith.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, thanks for keeping the faith.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Hey, thanks for keeping the faith.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Hey, thanks for keeping the faith.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What does that mean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What does that mean?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Thanks for the heads up, I guess?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Thanks for the heads up, I guess?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Thanks for the heads up, I guess?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Thanks for the heads up, I guess?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Will do.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Will do.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You'd do that for me?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You'd do that for me?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Fair trade. What do you need?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Fair trade. What do you need?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Fair trade. What do you need?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Fair trade. What do you need?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Can you really call it a favor if you're asking for something in return?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Can you really call it a favor if you're asking for something in return?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Can you really call it a favor if you're asking for something in return?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Can you really call it a favor if you're asking for something in return?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alright, what is it and where's it going?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright, what is it and where's it going?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Alright, what is it and where's it going?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Alright, what is it and where's it going?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Another driver can't deliver it?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Another driver can't deliver it?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Count me in.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Count me in.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I can't take the risk.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I can't take the risk.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the favor?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the favor?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Health Code Violations?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Health Code Violations?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't want to know.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want to know.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What's the worst you've seen?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's the worst you've seen?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Yeah.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's disgusting.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's disgusting.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: If it's the only place to put it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If it's the only place to put it.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: If it's the only place to put it.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: If it's the only place to put it.
